crossRefs.note: “You shall not spread a false report. Don’t join your hand with the wicked to be a malicious witness.
“ ‘You shall not steal. “ ‘You shall not lie. “ ‘You shall not deceive one another.
If an unrighteous witness rises up against any man to testify against him of wrongdoing,
If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.
Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.
Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.
He who walks righteously and speaks blamelessly, he who despises the gain of oppressions, who gestures with his hands…
Soldiers also asked him, saying, “What about us? What must we do?” He said to them, “Extort from no one by violence…
Therefore putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor. For we are members of one another.
Abstain from every form of evil.
‘Cursed is he who takes a bribe to kill an innocent person.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’
keeping loving kindness for thousands, forgiving iniquity and disobedience and sin; and who will by no means clear the…
He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to Yahweh.
Yahweh is slow to anger, and great in power, and will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. Yahweh has his way in…
For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men who suppress the truth…
But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath…
who “will pay back to everyone according to their works:”

translations.web: “Keep far from a false charge, and don’t kill the innocent and righteous; for I will not justify the wicked.
translations.bsb: Stay far away from a false accusation. Do not kill the innocent or the just, for I will not acquit the guilty.
translations.kjv: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.
translations.asv: Keep thee far from a false matter; and the innocent and righteous slay thou not: for I will not justify the wicked.
